result.rationale: In GoogleCalendarService the diff changes `const key = googleCredentialSchema.parse(googleCredentials)` to `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema)`. The new helper (shown in the diff) returns the full `safeParse` result (`refreshTokenResponse`, i.e. `{success, data}`) rather than unwrapped data, and GoogleCalendarService does not destructure it, so the wrapper object is persisted as `credential.key`, corrupting the stored format — unlike the Zoom/Office365 call sites which use `.success && .data` on the return.
